story.review_method: Read complete original and complete revision, compare changed paragraphs and preserved incident sequence. Prose review only; no illustration clearance.

observations: Independent reviewer opened all three current sheets at native resolution, originals and native detail crops; no material findings. Qualitative scale and grooming states remain provisional.
Neet three support paws and one reaching forepaw have continuous shoulder/leg ownership; Buddy lifted paw and other three floor contacts are clear.
Bangle is flat, separate from toes; paw nudge is consistent with prose unspecified nudge. Bazaar rack is subordinate, expressions attentive versus politely reluctant.
Rough directional coat hatching must be replaced by smooth tonal close-coat finish; no finished illustration reviewed yet.
Every current finished image opened at full resolution against original photos; concrete findings recorded per image.

sequence: Cow challenge and carried defender joke
inspection.independence: Did not write revised story or generate illustrations. This is a whole-reading review; native-resolution photographic/anatomy review remains the separately pinned visual review.

observations.humor_and_voices: Neet loses a staredown with stationary jars, practices stern expressions with an obliging reflection and claims victory over an indifferent cow. Buddy has distinct practical humor and changes his stated quiet-corner requirement for kachoris; sitting still makes Heather pause. Heather participates through Oh, now we like shopping and the affectionate portable-protector line. These jokes vary between reaction, physical refusal and reversal rather than repeat a catchphrase.
observations.causality_and_pacing: The market route gives clear progression from smell to glitter to food to street encounter. The second sneeze motivates Neet backing off; food motivates Buddy refusing to leave; Heather picks Neet up before any cow approach. Illustration breaks follow completed exchanges and keep speaker attribution intact.
observations.heart_and_payoff: Warmth stays in practical care, shared purchases and the cushion rest. Anklet sound recalls the earlier jewelry scene without extending the quiet ending; Buddy keeping both eyes shut is an earned closing reaction. Historical Heather/Meera household remains intact.

image_state_and_complementarity.observation: Appears after the losing reply: Neet stands back watching the jars and Buddy shelters behind Heather. No premature biscuit handoff; dog-eye viewpoint makes the motionless jars imposing.

Follows the short paw-refusal action: ring remains on ground, Neet offers it and Buddy lifts a paw away. This captures the just-narrated gesture rather than inventing a worn bangle. Close two-dog negotiation supplies physical comedy distinct from spice defensiveness.

Appears after portable-protector line while still in market: Neet is carried, cow travels past without attending him, Buddy stays beside Heather outside its forward path. Wider scale contrast completes the reversal before the home transition.

observations.finish_continuity: Bangle replacement uses visibly flatter dog coat planes than the other two images. At reading size the shared palette, character shapes and warm detailed bazaar retain continuity; the difference is noticeable but not a material reading defect. No curly torso strands reappear in rendered replacement.
